rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The protocol is headed 'ВЫБОРЫ ПРЕЗИДЕНТА РОССИЙСКОЙ ФЕДЕРАЦИИ 16 ИЮНЯ 1996 ГОДА'.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Summing 89 subject-commission protocols and 397 protocols of polling stations abroad, the CEC determines: 108,495,023 voters on the lists; 74,515,019 valid and 1,072,120 invalid ballots; 75,744,549 voters took part in the election; ten candidates, among them 'ЕЛЬЦИН БОРИС НИКОЛАЕВИЧ' 26,665,495 votes, 'ЗЮГАНОВ ГЕННАДИЙ АНДРЕЕВИЧ' 24,211,686 and 'ЛЕБЕДЬ АЛЕКСАНДР ИВАНОВИЧ' 10,974,736; against all 1,163,921. Chairman N. T. Ryabov heads the signature block. 'Протокол составлен "20" июня 1996 года'.

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only. Election calling, voting, result determination, declaration, correction and publication, oath, stated assumption of office, inauguration ceremony, resignation, acting service and outgoing-holder statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-05 RSFSR roles and the USSR packet are outside this extract.
